other_engines.note: No free keyless index-status API exists for Bing or Yandex. Bing Webmaster Tools has one (GET /webmaster/api.svc/json/GetUrlTrafficInfo etc.) but it needs an API key from a signed-in account, which is a human step; Yandex Webmaster likewise needs OAuth. Neither key exists in this repo, so those channels are reported UNMEASURED.
other_engines.bing: UNMEASURED — the positive control returned 0 results on a domain that is certainly indexed (HTTP 200), so this probe cannot see the index at all. A zero for our host would be a broken probe, not an absent site.
other_engines.mojeek: UNMEASURED — the positive control returned 0 results on a domain that is certainly indexed (HTTP 200), so this probe cannot see the index at all. A zero for our host would be a broken probe, not an absent site.
other_engines.duckduckgo: UNMEASURED — the positive control returned 0 results on a domain that is certainly indexed (HTTP 202), so this probe cannot see the index at all. A zero for our host would be a broken probe, not an absent site.

probes.label: positive control, a site certainly in Bing

human_gated_alternatives: Bing Webmaster Tools: sign in, create an API key, then GetUrlTrafficInfo / GetUrlWithQueryStats per URL (free).
Yandex Webmaster: OAuth app + token, then /user/{id}/hosts/{host}/search-urls/in-search (free).
